issues.concern: The main gloss combines two distinct senses without indicating they are separate, which is misleading. The second sense ('water-based; aqueous') is a different usage (as a prefix/modifier) than the first ('water system; river system; watershed').
issues.suggestion: Split the main gloss into two distinct senses or rephrase to clearly separate them, e.g., 'water system; river system; watershed; (as prefix) water-based; aqueous'.
